The '''Korriban's Flame''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] maintained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Located just east of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Huk/Legends|Huk]] and the [[Kalee system/Legends|Kalee system]], the station served a trap for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jomar Chul]] and the [[Hero of Tython]], as part of the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Leeha Narezz]]'s attempt to capture the Hero.
